purpose.statement: DevOps Asiana exists to provide professional accountability for technology operations in an increasingly AI-operated computing environment. The Firm provides professional technology operations, engineering, reliability, infrastructure, security, integration, and related advisory services, and supervises, authorizes, operates, reviews, verifies, and stands behind technology work performed by human professionals, automation, software systems, and artificial-intelligence agents within defined Client Engagements and delegated authority.
initial_market_specialization: Other institutions operating regulated or critical technology infrastructure
purpose.scope_boundary: The constitutional purpose remains broad enough to serve other organizations operating critical information or technology infrastructure.
purpose.professional_doctrine: AI can perform the work. The Firm accepts responsibility for the work.
incidental_capacity: Lease property and establish offices or facilities
Acquire equipment, software, and professional services
Engage professionals, employ personnel, and contract with vendors
Develop internal operational tooling and intellectual property
Acquire professional capabilities and maintain reserves
Invest in infrastructure necessary or incidental to the practice
Perform lawful activities necessary or incidental to the Firm's professional services

continuity.statement: The Firm is intended to continue notwithstanding changes in the identity, role, or tenure of individual Partners, to the fullest extent permitted by applicable law and the Partnership Agreement.
continuity.doctrine: Partners may change. The Firm is intended to endure.
continuity.scope: Admission, withdrawal, retirement, death, incapacity, succession, and changes in management office are not the desired end of the institution. The Firm is intended to serve multiple generations of Partners; its lifespan and Client relationships are not limited to the Founding Partners' participation.
continuity.authority_boundary: Economic value may survive a Partner. Professional and governance authority does not automatically pass to heirs. Partner admission, Reserved Matters, succession controls, Responsible Partner accountability, and authority rules remain intact.
continuity.commencement_boundary: A term decision, successful compilation, or repository state does not commence the Firm. Commencement remains unresolved and requires its own institutional decision and necessary legal or formal acts.

decisions.label: Institutional purpose
decisions.statement: The Firm exists to provide bounded professional accountability for AI-amplified technology operations, initially serving regulated or critical financial infrastructure while retaining a broad institutional purpose.

decisions.label: Partnership term and institutional continuity intent
decisions.statement: DevOps Asiana is intended to have indefinite institutional duration and to continue notwithstanding changes in individual Partners, to the fullest extent permitted by applicable law and the Partnership Agreement. The Firm is intended to terminate only upon an applicable dissolution event followed by an orderly winding-up process. Formal Philippine legal or SEC wording and partner-change continuation mechanics require counsel review. In particular, legal continuation after the departure, death, incapacity, or other loss of one of only two Partners must not be inferred from institutional intent.

decisions.label: Dissolution and winding-up mechanics
decisions.statement: The Firm is intended to terminate only through an applicable dissolution event and orderly winding up, rather than expiration of an arbitrary fixed term. Final dissolution triggers, required Partner decisions, and winding-up mechanics remain unresolved and require Philippine counsel review. No withdrawal, retirement, death, incapacity, expulsion, estate, succession, redemption, or valuation procedure is selected by the continuity doctrine.

decisions.label: Initial capital contributions
decisions.statement: No amount, form, timing, or contribution obligation has been decided.

decisions.label: Capital ownership and liquidation interests
decisions.statement: Governance and Engagement economics do not determine capital interests.

decisions.label: 50/50 governance deadlock mechanism
decisions.statement: No deadlock escalation, mediation, casting vote, buy-sell, or dissolution mechanism has been selected.

decisions.label: Founder dilution protection mechanics
decisions.statement: Founder protections are intended; their legal mechanics, limits, and duration require counsel.

decisions.label: Partner retirement mechanics
decisions.statement: Notice, transition, economic treatment, and redemption have not been decided.

decisions.label: Partner death and incapacity mechanics
decisions.statement: Authority is personal and economic value may survive, but implementation remains unresolved.

decisions.label: Buyout and redemption valuation
decisions.statement: No valuation method, date, funding method, or payment terms have been selected.
